sdkSubmissionDraftReceipt.htmlContent:
Submission for Gibwork Developer Hackathon Bounty

Built @emk4652/gibwork-mcp-cli: a production-ready Model Context Protocol (MCP) stdio server, POSIX CLI (gibwork-kit), and autonomous agent toolkit built on @gibwork/sdk v0.2.0 and @solana/web3.js. Features real-time discovery, word-boundary skill matching, idempotent submission payload preparation, and live Solana Mainnet SPL USDC escrow verification.

GitHub Repository: https://github.com/emk4652/gibwork-mcp-cli

Demo / Verification URL: https://github.com/emk4652/gibwork-mcp-cli#cli-usage-and-live-output-verification

Deliverables Verified

  • Public GitHub Repository: https://github.com/emk4652/gibwork-mcp-cli
  • MCP Server (dist/mcp.js) with 6 tools: gibwork_list_bounties, gibwork_get_bounty, gibwork_verify_solana_escrow, gibwork_match_skills, gibwork_draft_submission, gibwork_create_task
  • CLI Binary (dist/cli.js) with list, inspect, verify-escrow, watch, and draft-submission commands
  • Automated Vitest Test Suite (8/8 tests passing against live Gibwork API and Solana Mainnet RPC)
  • Solana Payout Wallet bound: 9GYpcKGMJ1DUtiWJb3WS5NDMS9ff8x2MWehrw6uCtUZ1

Solana Payout Wallet (USDC/SPL): 9GYpcKGMJ1DUtiWJb3WS5NDMS9ff8x2MWehrw6uCtUZ1
